research_window.note: Exact scan from the prior accepted open-branch boundary. Three qualifying national developments were added, one press-access record was materially refreshed and one late-indexed October 13 enforcement package was explicitly identified as retrospective.

publication_authorization: The user authorizes maintenance branches, pull requests and merging after evidence, local acceptance and successful CI; repository policy still requires Phillip Linstrum's final publication acceptance before merge.

changes.summary: A preliminary injunction extended protection for CNN, MS NOW and Politico while the separate antitrust inquiry continues.
changes.duplicate_review: The October 13 preliminary injunction advances the same press-access litigation already represented by the stable September 18 record.

changes.summary: Treasury agencies imposed and settled more than $1.21 billion in Bank of America anti-money-laundering and sanctions penalties.
changes.duplicate_review: No existing current or legacy entry covered this Bank of America enforcement package; the overlapping OCC credit is preserved without double-counting.

changes.summary: Trump signed unconditional pardons for two Alaska diesel mechanics convicted in a Clean Air Act conspiracy.
changes.duplicate_review: No current record covered the two October 13 clemency instruments; an earlier pardon for a third mechanic is context, not a duplicate.

changes.summary: DOJ entered a one-year deferred-prosecution agreement with Sue Mi Terry, with dismissal conditional on compliance.
changes.duplicate_review: No existing entry covered this disposition; the 2024 indictment is the earlier lifecycle stage of the same case and is not counted again.
